name: Magicana ~ Fennec Play
source:
Game Jam entry for Ludum Dare #35 - Shapeshifters

At Rosemarie Academy, a school for young witches, three girls find a mysterious girl- however, she's on the run! Can the girls save her?

[From [url=https://mikomikisomi.itch.io/magicana-fennec-play]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Ludum Dare第35届Game Jam“变形者”主题参赛作品。

在年轻女巫就读的罗斯玛丽学院，三个女孩发现了一个神秘女孩——然而，她正在逃亡！女孩们能救她吗？

[来源：[url=https://mikomikisomi.itch.io/magicana-fennec-play]itch.io[/url]]
